The quote number, title, totals, terms and validity date — but not the individual line items. This signature was recorded before line items were included in the digest, so the hash cannot evidence them. The line items themselves are unchanged by this; they are simply outside what this hash can prove.
The quote number, title, every line item with its quantity and price, the totals, the terms and the validity date.
This certificate documents a simple electronic signature.
The hash is reported exactly as it was recorded; it has not been recalculated.

The content hash is a SHA-256 digest, computed at the moment of signing, of the content listed under “Hash covers” above — recomputing that same content today and getting the same hash proves those parts of the document have not been altered since.
A matching hash therefore does not, on this signature, say anything about the line items.
No content hash was recorded for this signature, so this certificate evidences the decision, the signer and the moment — not the document’s contents.
Timestamp, IP address, and device information were recorded when the signer submitted their decision via the private signing link.
